description: Use this when someone asks what waist size is healthy for their height or sex, such as "healthy waist size for 5 ft 8 man", "ideal waist for 160 cm woman" or "what should my waist be". Gives half your height and the Indian cutoff. Do not use for children, pregnancy, or medical diagnosis.

height_ft.description: Height feet part, if not using centimetres

height_in.description: Height inches part, used with height_ft

name: waist_target
title: Waist size to stay under
